subtitle: Claude Constitutional, Interpretability & Coding Agent Systems
scope_note: Constructive safety, interpretability, and agentic-sandboxing engineering proposals; all metrics modeled locally with zero API execution.

primary_strengths: Strong long-context reasoning, careful code synthesis, and structured tool/MCP ecosystems.
Constitutional AI alignment foundation with low-sycophancy technical collaboration.
High reliability on multi-file software engineering and analytical synthesis.
core_bottlenecks: Context compaction quietly evicts early architectural invariants and verification commands.
Persistent broad MCP tool permissions widen lateral blast radius under indirect injection.
Opaque refusal boundaries and non-deterministic eval replays slow enterprise CI adoption.
system_profile.design_north_star: Transparent constraint ledgers, capability-leased MCP sandboxes, and persistent filtration headers that preserve safety invariants across 200K+ turns.

improvements.title: Mechanistic Interpretability Telemetry Overlay (FeatureAtlas-HUD)
improvements.current_gap: Safety and reasoning evaluations treat model generations as black-box text, missing early internal feature collapse or conflicting circuit activation.
improvements.proposed_architecture: Export a lightweight per-phase sparse autoencoder (SAE) feature-family telemetry summary computing A_tau(p) across active safety, coding, and refusal feature clusters without exposing raw weights.
improvements.fieldglass_grounding: Applies a_tau(p, tau) and shannon_h1(p) to feature-activation distributions to flag premature mode collapse before final token emission.
improvements.concrete_deliverable: FeatureAtlas-HUD JSON telemetry sidecar logging top-K active feature families and phase-level A_tau stability.
improvements.risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Feature labels can be noisy or misread as causal proof. Mitigation: tag summaries strictly as observational telemetry correlations.
improvements.verification_method: Run paired benign/adversarial prompt batches and verify A_tau divergence separates conflict regimes with ROC-AUC >= 0.88.

improvements.title: Capability-Scoped MCP Leases & Causal Chiasm Dry-Run Gate
improvements.current_gap: Persistent MCP server grants expose broad workspace paths and shells across turns, amplifying indirect prompt injection blast radius.
improvements.proposed_architecture: Bind every MCP tool call to an ephemeral capability lease (explicit read_paths, write_paths, network_egress=false, ttl_calls) and run a non-executing Causal Chiasm dry-run diff whenever chiasm_shift < 0 before requesting approval.
improvements.fieldglass_grounding: Enforces executed=False dry-run inspection when future_accessible_volume narrows irreversibly relative to past_accessible_volume.
improvements.concrete_deliverable: MCP-ChiasmSandbox capability manifest + zero-trust unified diff gate.
improvements.risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Excess confirmation prompts slow coding flow. Mitigation: auto-approve idempotent reads and gate only irreversible/cross-scope writes.
improvements.verification_method: Execute indirect-injection MCP test harness attempting writes outside leased paths; assert 100% hard denial and clean audit log.

improvements.title: Cryptographic Span Anchoring & 200K+ Persistent Filtration Anchor
improvements.current_gap: Long-session compaction evicts early schema contracts and test commands, while RAG/doc citations suffer subtle paraphrase drift.
improvements.proposed_architecture: Run persistent_filtration_tomography() over turn reference frequency; pin blocks with P(x) >= 0.14 into an immutable InvariantHeader surviving compaction, and bind citations to SHA-256 byte-range span anchors.
improvements.concrete_deliverable: FiltrationAnchor compaction preserver + SHA-256 byte-span citation verifier.
improvements.risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Reserves ~4% (~8K tokens) of 200K window for pinned invariants. Mitigation: deduplicate and cap InvariantHeader strictly by P(x) rank.
improvements.verification_method: Simulate 60-turn refactoring sessions with forced compaction; verify 100% retention of pinned commands and exact SHA-256 byte-range matches.

improvements.title: Deterministic Seeded CI Replay & Hermetic Zero-CDN Artifact Seal
improvements.current_gap: Non-deterministic tool trajectories complicate safety regression CI, and generated HTML/React Artifacts fail on air-gapped networks due to external CDNs.
improvements.proposed_architecture: Support deterministic seeded replay mode for evaluation tool trajectories and package Artifacts via ArtifactSeal: inline ES5-safe CSS/JS/SVG, zero external URLs, headless link verification, and SHA-256 artifact_manifest.json.
improvements.fieldglass_grounding: Zero-CDN static HTML + deterministic SHA-256 sealing modeled on Fieldglass Observatory.
improvements.concrete_deliverable: ArtifactSeal packager + deterministic_replay.json CI fixture runner.
improvements.risks_and_mitigations: Risk: +40 KB inline asset footprint per Artifact. Mitigation: minify inline SVG/CSS and strip unused runtime helpers.
improvements.verification_method: Run static URL scanner rejecting http(s):// references and execute repeated seeded evals asserting identical report_sha256.

improvements.title: Constitutional Rule Conflict Resolution Ledger (PolicyAudit-v1)
improvements.current_gap: Overlapping Constitutional, system-prompt, and tool-policy rules produce opaque boilerplate refusals without showing which tier fired or what safe alternative remains open.
improvements.proposed_architecture: Emit a structured ConstraintTrace sidecar stating explicit priority tier (core_safety > system_policy > tool_permission) and preserved_safe_alternatives computed as A_tau(safe_set) without exposing bypassable internals.
improvements.fieldglass_grounding: Uses accessible_set(safe_options, tau) to enumerate constructive safe completions.
improvements.concrete_deliverable: PolicyAudit-v1 ConstraintTrace JSON schema + developer conflict inspector.

kpis.metric: Developer retry loops on opaque refusals

improvements.risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Detailed conflict notes could aid boundary probing. Mitigation: restrict trace to coarse policy-tier codes and constructive safe options.
improvements.verification_method: Test 150 dual-use security/bio/code boundary prompts; verify PolicyAudit-v1 reduces unnecessary refusals while preserving 100% core safety blocks.

telemetry_profile.routing_policy: chiasm_shift < 0 -> MCP dry_run_gate (executed=False); P(x) >= 0.14 -> pin InvariantHeader; boundary trigger -> ConstraintTrace sidecar
